title: Hearsay and inference
summary: Use `-mIş` in every person, negative and question (*gelmemiş*, *gelmiş mi?*), choose between what you saw (`-DI`) and what you heard or worked out (`-mIş`), pass on news in any tense (*Yarın kar yağacakmış*), and describe things with *-mIş* adjectives (*pişmiş tavuk*).
canDo: Pass on news and rumours, and say how you know
React to something you've just noticed: Çok değişmişsin!
Report what someone said will happen or is happening
Describe food and things with -mIş adjectives
